Interface IMessageable

All Known Subinterfaces:
ICommandSender, IPlayer, IServer
All Known Implementing Classes:
SpigotServer, WrappedOfflinePlayer, WrappedPlayer
public interface IMessageable
Represents objects that can receive messages.

    • sendMessage

      default void sendMessage(TextType textType, String key, Text.ArgumentCreator... args)
      Sends a message to this object.

      This is a shortcut for sendMessage(Text).

      Parameters:
      textType - The TextType to use for the message to send.
      key - The key of the error message. E.g. constants.error.generic.
      args - The arguments to use for the message.

    • sendError

      default void sendError(String key, Text.ArgumentCreator... args)
      Sends an error message to this messageable.

      This is a shortcut for sendMessage(TextType, String, Text.ArgumentCreator...) with the TextType.ERROR type.

      Parameters:
      key - The key of the error message. E.g. constants.error.generic.
      args - The arguments to use for the message, if any.
